metric_scope: Synthetic mechanical expectations only; no semantic accuracy or production-rate claim.

results.title: Named arguments may move
results.rationale: Reordering named placeholders preserves binding; both identities and counts are unchanged.

results.title: Template whitespace and repeated occurrences
results.rationale: Whitespace inside supported double-brace names is insignificant; both repeated occurrences remain.

results.title: Explicit printf positions may move
results.rationale: Explicit argument positions allow word-order changes without rebinding.

results.title: Declared German grouping and decimals
results.rationale: The supported en/de profiles represent the same decimal quantity with different separators.

results.title: Unicode decimal digits preserve value
results.rationale: Arabic-Indic decimal digits represent the same integer value.

results.title: Balanced nested tags retain structure
results.rationale: Only visible words change; tag identities, counts and nesting remain identical.

results.title: Attribute placeholders are retained
results.rationale: The raw attribute placeholder and balanced tag are unchanged.

results.title: Equivalent locale spelling and Unicode normalization
results.rationale: A same-locale copy is allowed; precomposed and decomposed accents are canonically equivalent.

results.title: Escaped percent remains literal
results.rationale: The percent escape is literal and the numeric quantity remains 100.

results.title: Unicode minus and quantity reordering
results.rationale: U+2212 is the supported minus sign; numeric order can change while signed values remain equal.

results.title: CSV quotes, commas and embedded newline
results.rationale: CSV serialization must preserve punctuation and multiline text without creating records.

results.title: Integer zero is a valid identifier
results.rationale: The identifier contract permits integer zero; it must not be treated as absent.

results.title: Whitespace-only translation
results.rationale: A present but blank value is empty, not missing.
